headline: Cloudflare Builds Audits That Challenge Themselves
lede: This coding-agent module turns security review into a six-phase operating plan: reconnaissance, hunting, verification, and structured reporting. Independent agents challenge each finding, while JSON ledgers preserve coverage and separate confirmed flaws from unresolved leads.

headline: PHP Keeps Its Engine Tuned
lede: The official PHP source tree contains the interpreter, Zend Engine, standard library, extensions, and the tests that hold them together. Build it from source to inspect runtime behavior, develop language changes, or push performance through a mature systems stack.

headline: Claude Learns the Shape of Work
lede: Anthropic’s plugin collection gives Claude role-specific skills, commands, and connectors for environments built around Jira, Slack, Notion, and data warehouses. Its file-based architecture lets teams encode domain procedures without standing up a new application layer.

headline: OpenShell Puts Agents Behind Policy
lede: NVIDIA’s runtime gives autonomous agents useful access without handing them the keys to the host. Sandboxes, kernel controls, credential handling, and human approval gates define a defensive perimeter across local machines, containers, and Kubernetes.

headline: A Charting Engine Preserves Zi Wei Dou Shu
lede: This TypeScript and Next.js project translates a traditional Chinese astrology system into reproducible computation. Calendar conversion, true-solar-time correction, star transformations, classical texts, and large chart datasets make the repository both a working engine and a specialized research archive.

headline: Claude Red Maps the Offensive Surface
lede: Claude Red packages offensive-security methods as modular skill files covering reconnaissance, web flaws, cloud, wireless, identity, exploitation, and post-exploitation. The material is designed for authorized red teams, bug hunters, CTF learners, and defenders who need to understand an attack chain before closing it.

headline: VoxCPM Gives Speech a Continuous Voice
lede: VoxCPM’s tokenizer-free architecture generates expressive multilingual speech with a two-billion-parameter model, controllable voice design, and short-reference cloning. Open weights, 48 kHz output, streaming interfaces, and deployment paths from CPU to CUDA make its benchmark relevant beyond the demo.

headline: Node.js Remains the Runtime at Scale
lede: Node.js pairs V8 with event-driven, non-blocking I/O for servers, command-line tools, and network-heavy applications. Its mature standard library, npm ecosystem, release channels, and long-term support keep the JavaScript runtime embedded in modern infrastructure.
